scripts.lint: biome check src puppeteer.config.js package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.format: biome check --write src puppeteer.config.js package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.smoke: node dist/index.js --file exampleData.yaml --template green-columns --no-pdf && node dist/index.js --file exampleData.yaml --template man-page --no-pdf
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync, readdirSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; if (existsSync('dist')) for (const entry of readdirSync('dist')) if (entry !== '.gitkeep') rmSync('dist/' + entry, { recursive: true, force: true });"
